verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://clickhouse.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a real ClickHouse description. Doc pages are served as markdown (for example cli.md and MCP.md), which suits agents reading the docs directly. The CLI docs also offer official agent skills for coding agents, another agent-oriented docs channel. Missing for 10: no hands-on or independent evidence of agents actually using llms.txt or the markdown docs, the root docs.md index returns 404, and the depth and coverage of llms.txt is unverified beyond its header.
